P.name: Blaze
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Brand's''' {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Ablaze'' to enemies hit for 4 seconds, stacking up to 3 times and refreshing the duration of all stacks with each application. Subsequent abilities used against a target with ''Ablaze'' are empowered. Killing an enemy afflicted with ''Ablaze'' or any enemy with an ability restores {{as|{{pp|20 to 40 for 5|1;6 to 15|changedisplay=true|formula=20 at level 1, then +5 every 3 levels starting at level 6 and capped at level 15}} {{sti|mana}}}}.
P.description2: {{sbc|Ablaze:}} While afflicted with ''Ablaze'', the target is dealt {{as|magic damage}} equal to{{ft|{{as|2% of their '''maximum''' health}} over 4 seconds.|{{as|{{ap|2/12|round=3}}% of their '''maximum''' health}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds over 4 seconds.}}Each stack of ''Ablaze'' deals damage to the target individually and applies their damage ticks dependent on the time they were applied, even if the duration of all the stacks are refreshed. ''Ablaze'' deals 270% damage per tick to {{tip|monsters}}; this damage is capped at{{ft|{{pp|50/4 to (50/4)*3|1;2;3|type=''Ablaze'' stacks}} per tick against non-epic monsters and {{pp|80/4 to (80/4)*3|1;2;3|type=''Ablaze'' stacks}} per tick against epic monsters.|a total of {{pp|50*4 to 50*4*3|1;2;3|type=''Ablaze'' stacks}} against non-epic monsters and {{pp|80*4 to 80*4*3|1;2;3|type=''Ablaze'' stacks}} against epic monsters.}}
P.description3: Upon applying 3 stacks of ''Ablaze'' to a large {{tip|monster}} or enemy {{tip|champion}}, the fire becomes unstable, causing it to form a fiery ring around the target that grants {{tip|sight}} within its radius and, after 2 seconds, consumes their stacks to explode. All enemies within the detonation are applied a stack of ''Ablaze'' and dealt {{as|magic damage}} equal to {{as|{{pplevel|6 to 12|key=%}} {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} of their '''maximum''' health}}, capped at {{pp|270 to 525|1;6;11;16}} against {{tip|monsters}}.
P.description4: '''Brand''' cannot stack ''Ablaze'' more than once on enemies that have had a ring explode from them in the last 4 seconds.
P.description5: ''The ring will form even if the target dies to the ability applying the third stack, and will still trigger the explosion if the target dies before it.''

Q.name: Sear
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Brand''' launches a fireball in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit.
Q.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|Blaze|Brand|Ablaze}} Bonus:}} The target is {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|1.75}} seconds.

W.name: Pillar of Flame
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} After a {{rutngt|0.625}} delay, '''Brand''' erupts a pillar of flame at the target location that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
W.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|Blaze|Brand|Ablaze}} Bonus:}} The target takes 25% increased damage.

E.name: Conflagration
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Brand''' sets the target enemy aflame, which creates a blast that deals {{as|magic damage}} to them and causes the flame to spread from the target to nearby enemies, dealing them the same damage.

R.name: Pyroclasm
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Brand''' launches a fireball at the target enemy that bounces between nearby enemies and '''Brand''' up to four times, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies each time and having a {{fd|0.15}}-second delay between bounces.
R.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|100 to 250}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}|Total Single-Target Damage|{{ap|100*3 to 250*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*3}}% AP)}}}}
R.description2: ''Pyroclasm'' prioritizes ''{{ai|Blaze|Brand|Ablaze}}'' enemy champions, then other enemy champions, then any valid bounce target, then '''Brand'''.
R.description3: {{sbc|{{ai|Blaze|Brand|Ablaze}} Bonus:}} The target is {{tip|slow|slowed}} for {{fd|0.25}} seconds. This can affect the same enemy more than once.
R.description4: ''The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} for the fireball to bounce to them.''
